content_html_sanitized:
There are reports that President Trump is going to move marijuana from Schedule 1 to Schedule 3.

See Recreational, Sacramental and Medical: Why There’s No Clear Delineation Between Recreational and Medical Cannabis

And Marijuana Is In Schedule One. Fentanyl Is In Schedule 2. Think About It

 

So, Charlie Kirk, who is an expert on everything because he is a big time “Christian Nationalist” and Trump supporter, was quoted as saying,  “I hope this doesn’t happen. We need to protect public spaces for kids. Everything already smells like weed, which is ridiculous. Let’s make it harder to ruin public spaces, not easier,”

 

According to Wikipedia, “Kirk co-wrote, with Brent Hamachek, the 2016 book Time for a Turning Point: Setting a Course Toward Free Markets and Limited Government for Future Generations.”

 

So he wants the Federal government to rule that a plant that has been used as medicine for millennia is not medicine so it can’t be smoked in a park. Limited government?

 

From Wikipedia, “Since switching from secularism to Christianity, Kirk has been described as a Christian nationalistwho has advocated for the end of the separation of Church and state in the United States.In 2024, Kirk stated, "One of the reasons we’re living through a constitutional crisis is that we no longer have a Christian nation, but we have a Christian form of government, and they’re incompatible. You cannot have liberty if you do not have a Christian population". Kirk promotes the Seven Mountain Mandate, a Dominion theology concept which calls for Christians to control seven spheres of society (government, education, media, arts and entertainment, business, family, and religion). Kirk uses his Christian nationalist stance to advance an apocalyptic world view of politics and to demonise political opponents, such as the Democratic Party.”

 

Jesus who? From Matthew 25:42-46, Jesus said to his disciples,

For I was hungry, and you didn’t feed me. I was thirsty, and you didn’t give me a drink. I was a stranger, and you didn’t invite me into your home. I was naked, and you didn’t give me clothing. I was sick and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

“Then they will reply, ‘Lord, when did we ever see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or naked or sick or in prison, and not help you?’ 

“And he will answer, ‘I tell you the truth, when you refused to help the least of these my brothers and sisters, you were refusing to help me.’

But Lord, we arrested millions of people in your name and kept cannabosm in Schedule 1 in thy name.

And Reefer Madness Reflections on all that an ancient plant continues to offer.
